no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input, and your AI reads the rows you already hold and gives them as held; the tool keeps nothing and answers the rows for your AI to keep.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep what I know about a prospect as one row of my prospect list: what a finder found, the researched profile, a status I move it through, and my notes", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-a-prospect and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: One row per prospect, under the key you give; keeping it again writes over the same row and leaves the fields you keep by hand.
4. It reads and keeps nothing: it works from your request and answers its whole result; you keep any row it answers.
